judgment.rationale: The supplied VCP capability list establishes that the monitor responds to DDC/CI queries, but it does not establish why Power Display excludes it from enumeration or whether Windows reports it through the required display path.
evidence: The reporter says an LG HDR 4K monitor does not appear despite Hide monitor being unticked.
The follow-up supplies a VCP capability list including brightness and input-source controls.
Power Display receives RefreshMonitors actions; common display enumeration uses EnumDisplayMonitors and monitor device data.
No diagnostic ZIP, connection topology, Power Display version, or monitor-report output is attached.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a focused current-build monitor enumeration report and connection topology instead of a generic broad log request.

fix_assessment.rationale: VCP support alone does not identify the missing discovery/filtering boundary, so a PowerToys code change would be speculative.

issue_context.summary: A monitor with documented DDC/CI VCP capabilities is absent from Power Display's monitor list without an explanatory status.
known_information: The monitor is described as LG HDR 4K.
The reporter supplied a detailed public VCP capability listing.
The issue is on 0.101.2362.0 and has no diagnostic archive.
inferences: The failure may be at display enumeration, physical-monitor association, capability probing, or a deliberate eligibility filter.
issue_context.analysis: The existing capability listing is useful and should not be requested again. A monitor-specific enumeration report and physical connection details would identify which discovery boundary needs investigation.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and follow-up capability list.
Inspected Power Display refresh entry points and common display monitor enumeration.
Searched live PowerToys issues for a directly matching LG HDR 4K Power Display report; no direct duplicate was found.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys monitor report, the monitor's connection type/dock or adapter path, and whether Windows Settings detects it as an active display.
information_gaps.why_needed: These facts distinguish missing Windows enumeration from DDC/CI probing or a Power Display eligibility decision.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Immediately after opening Power Display and confirming the monitor is missing, submit a comment containing /bugreport, then state the cable, adapter/dock, and whether the display is visible in Windows Settings.

comment.body: Thank you for the VCP capability list; it confirms the monitor responds to DDC/CI, so please do not repeat that output. To identify whether Power Display is missing the monitor during Windows enumeration, physical-monitor association, or capability filtering, please reproduce the missing entry on the current build and submit a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward. Please also state the cable and any dock/adapter path, plus whether Windows Settings shows the monitor as active.
